item.title: Dems use Iran to attack Trump on economy
item.summary: The minority party hopes to link the administration’s military operation with domestic issues.

item.title: Trump’s war aim: Iran’s ‘unconditional surrender’

item.title: Congress declines to halt Iran war

item.summary: A similar measure is also expected to fail in the House, giving the president near carte blanche to proceed with the conflict.

item.title: Lawmakers splinter on Trump administration’s case for war on Iran
item.summary: The administration made its case behind closed doors on Tuesday — and Republicans liked what they heard.

item.title: Trump is running out of time to sell his rationale for Iran war
item.summary: Senior officials keep offering justifications for the conflict with Tehran that the president upends.

item.title: GOP has the votes to crush Iran war rebuke, Johnson predicts
item.summary: Trump administration officials will brief lawmakers Tuesday ahead of high-stakes war powers votes this week.

item.title: Pentagon offers no evidence to support claim it attacked Iran in defense
item.summary: The Trump administration’s effort to construct a case for war after shots started flying has few historical parallels.

item.title: War with Iran has ‘only just begun,’ Hegseth says
item.summary: Top military officials said the campaign will intensify — and declined to say what victory might look like.

item.title: Iran strikes aren’t an ‘endless’ war, Pentagon policy chief argues
